entities.name: Query CoaBC protein
observations: 397 aa sequence; predicted molecular mass 43.8 kDa and pI 9.03.
Contains Flavoprotein domain PF02441 at residues 2-176 and DFP domain PF04127 at residues 183-393.
Shows 43.1% identity over 99.2% query coverage to reviewed Bacillus subtilis CoaBC O35033 (E-value 4.98e-91).
Most likely a bifunctional CoA biosynthesis enzyme with phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activities.
Homology supports Mg2+ and FMN association; exact substrate specificity is inferred rather than directly experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: CoaBC
observations: Reviewed bacterial bifunctional CoA biosynthesis enzyme; EC 6.3.2.5 and EC 4.1.1.36.
Catalyzes formation of 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine from 4'-phosphopantothenate, L-cysteine, and CTP, followed by decarboxylation to 4'-phosphopantetheine.
Binds FMN and uses Mg2+ according to reviewed homolog annotations.
